item.content:encoded: Bit of a necro, but they're like this less by design and moreso naturally inclined to behave this way. item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: "D-Class are clones" is definitely one of the directions that I anticipated being explored for the contest. This was a nice realization of that, in that it's not a faceless grouping of people being fed systematically into the system, but a particular person, engineered to have specific feelings that would make them pliable and easily adaptable to testing purposes, while still feeling fear. Clever humanization of a base concept that I'm not a huge fan of.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
This is… Stupid.

My reasons:

- Cloned D's (in process of turnign into a cliche).
- Excellent build up followed and lackluster twist.

You know? I think I am biased, and it's because of your own tale. The first part made a great attempt to feel sympathy towards this person. This human. Heck I almost upvoted at

The things they keep in these places kill men in ways that take weeks to clean up after. Break their minds and souls. They are the things of nightmares.

This could have been a great chance to portray a real man, with an actual background going straight to his certain death on his own volition because he believes in it. Self-aware of its fagility, he wouldn't care to die because of a sincere feeling that his actions would help to maintain those he knows and loves safe from the horrors he has witnessed…

And at the end it's just an artificial scenario. All fake for the purpose of testing.

I admit that I am a bit upset. It's like this tale tells me that the meaning of its existence is meaningless.

Enough of a rant. -1
